player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I assigned a high score to Anger (8) and Defensiveness (7) based on Elise's sharp retorts, but I overlooked Mike's specific reaction to her accusation that he "hides behind his books." Mike's immediate response was "Nothing. Forget it," which is a classic deflection tactic used to avoid admitting fault or explaining himself, rather than an angry outburst. His tone is resigned and self-protective, not aggressive. Next time, I will prioritize "Defensiveness" as the primary emotion (score 9) because his deflection directly addresses the accusation of hiding, and I will lower the score for Anger (score 2) since he did not escalate the conflict or express hostility, only retreat.
